name: gravity
tagline: A DNS filtering service for blocking ads malware and tracking domains
description: Gravity is a lightweight DNS and filtering proxy service for blocking malware, ads, and tracking. Designed for home networks and privacy enthusiasts, it supports per-device rules, stats, and a modern web UI.

features.title: DNS Blocking
features.description: Block ads and trackers using DNS filtering

features.title: Query Logging
features.description: View DNS queries and blocked requests

features.title: Web-Based Dashboard
features.description: Monitor DNS activity through a browser interface

features.title: Statistics
features.description: View summary statistics of blocked domains

features.title: Network Deployment
features.description: Use the DNS service within a local network
